verses.en: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.
verses.pt: Estas, pois, são as gerações dos filhos de Noé: Sem, Cão e Jafé, aos quais nasceram filhos depois do dilúvio.
verses.en_web: Now this is the history of the generations of the sons of Noah and of Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Sons were born to them after the flood.
verses.en_bbe: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: these are the sons which they had after the great flow of waters

verses.en: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Jafé: Gomer, Magogue, Madai, Javã, Tubal, Meseque e Tiras.
verses.en_web: The sons of Japheth were: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Japheth: Gomer and Magog and Madai and Javan and Tubal and Meshech and Tiras.

verses.en: And the sons of Gomer; Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Gomer: Asquenaz, Rifate e Togarma.
verses.en_web: The sons of Gomer were: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz and Riphath and Togarmah.

verses.en: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Javã: Elisá, Társis, Quitim e Dodanim.
verses.en_web: The sons of Javan were: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Javan: Elishah and Tarshish, the Kittim and the Dodanim.

verses.en: By these were the isles of the Gentiles divided in their lands; every one after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.
verses.pt: Por estes foram repartidas as ilhas das nações nas suas terras, cada qual segundo a sua língua, segundo as suas famílias, entre as suas nações.
verses.en_web: Of these were the islands of the nations divided in their lands, everyone after his language, after their families, in their nations.
verses.en_bbe: From these came the nations of the sea-lands, with their different families and languages.

verses.en: And the sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, and Phut, and Canaan.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Cão: Cuche, Mizraim, Pute e Canaã.
verses.en_web: The sons of Ham were: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Ham: Cush and Mizraim and Put and Canaan.

verses.en: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabtechah: and the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Cuche: Seba, Havilá, Sabtá, Raamá e Sabtecá; e os filhos de Raamá são Sebá e Dedã.
verses.en_web: The sons of Cush were: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah were: Sheba and Dedan.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Cush: Seba and Havilah and Sabtah and Raamah and Sabteca; and the sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

verses.en: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.
verses.pt: Cuche também gerou a Ninrode, o qual foi o primeiro a ser poderoso na terra.
verses.en_web: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one in the earth.
verses.en_bbe: And Cush was the father of Nimrod, who was the first of the great men of the earth.

verses.en: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD: wherefore it is said, Even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the LORD.
verses.pt: Ele era poderoso caçador diante do Senhor; pelo que se diz: Como Ninrode, poderoso caçador diante do Senhor.
verses.en_web: He was a mighty hunter before Yahweh. Therefore it is said, “like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before Yahweh”.
verses.en_bbe: He was a very great bowman, so that there is a saying, Like Nimrod, a very great bowman.

verses.en: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
verses.pt: O princípio do seu reino foi Babel, Ereque, Acade e Calné, na terra de Sinar.
verses.en_web: The beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
verses.en_bbe: And at the first, his kingdom was Babel and Erech and Accad and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

verses.en: Out of that land went forth Asshur, and builded Nineveh, and the city Rehoboth, and Calah,
verses.pt: Desta mesma terra saiu ele para a Assíria e edificou Nínive, Reobote-Ir, Calá,
verses.en_web: Out of that land he went into Assyria, and built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,
verses.en_bbe: From that land he went out into Assyria, building Nineveh with its wide streets and Calah,

verses.en: And Resen between Nineveh and Calah: the same is a great city.
verses.pt: e Résem entre Nínive e Calá (esta é a grande cidade).
verses.en_web: and Resen between Nineveh and the great city Calah.
verses.en_bbe: And Resen between Nineveh and Calah, which is a very great town.

verses.en: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,
verses.pt: Mizraim gerou a Ludim, Anamim, Leabim, Naftuim,
verses.en_web: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,
verses.en_bbe: And Mizraim was the father of the Ludim and Anamim and Lehabim and Naphtuhim;

verses.en: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (out of whom came Philistim,) and Caphtorim.
verses.pt: Patrusim, Casluim (donde saíram os filisteus) e Caftorim.
verses.en_web: Pathrusim, Casluhim (which the Philistines descended from), and Caphtorim.
verses.en_bbe: And Pathrusim and Casluhim and Caphtorim, from whom came the Philistines.

verses.en: And Canaan begat Sidon his firstborn, and Heth,
verses.pt: Canaã gerou a Sidom, seu primogênito, e Hete,
verses.en_web: Canaan became the father of Sidon (his firstborn), Heth,
verses.en_bbe: And Canaan was the father of Zidon, who was his oldest son, and Heth,

verses.en: And the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgasite,
verses.pt: e ao jebuseu, o amorreu, o girgaseu,
verses.en_web: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,
verses.en_bbe: And the Jebusite and the Amorite and the Girgashite,

verses.en: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
verses.pt: o heveu, o arqueu, o sineu,
verses.en_web: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,
verses.en_bbe: And the Hivite and the Arkite and the Sinite,

verses.en: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite: and afterward were the families of the Canaanites spread abroad.
verses.pt: o arvadeu, o zemareu e o hamateu. Depois se espalharam as famílias dos cananeus.
verses.en_web: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad.
verses.en_bbe: And the Arvadite and the Zemarite and the Hamathite; after that the families of the Canaanites went far and wide in all directions;

verses.en: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon, as thou comest to Gerar, unto Gaza; as thou goest, unto Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Admah, and Zeboim, even unto Lasha.
verses.pt: Foi o termo dos cananeus desde Sidom, em direção a Gerar, até Gaza; e daí em direção a Sodoma, Gomorra, Admá e Zeboim, até Lasa.
verses.en_web: The border of the Canaanites was from Sidon—as you go toward Gerar—to Gaza—as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim—to Lasha.
verses.en_bbe: Their country stretching from Zidon to Gaza, in the direction of Gerar; and to Lasha, in the direction of Sodom and Gomorrah and Admah and Zeboiim.

verses.en: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries, and in their nations.
verses.pt: São esses os filhos de Cão segundo as suas famílias, segundo as suas línguas, em suas terras, em suas nações.
verses.en_web: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, according to their languages, in their lands and their nations.
verses.en_bbe: All these, with their different families, languages, lands, and nations, are the offspring of Ham.

verses.en: Unto Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder, even to him were children born.
verses.pt: A Sem, que foi o pai de todos os filhos de Eber e irmão mais velho de Jafé, a ele também nasceram filhos.
verses.en_web: Children were also born to Shem, the father of all the children of Eber, the elder brother of Japheth.
verses.en_bbe: And Shem, the older brother of Japheth, the father of the children of Eber, had other sons in addition.

verses.en: The children of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Sem foram: Elão, Assur, Arfaxade, Lude e Arão.
verses.en_web: The sons of Shem were: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.
verses.en_bbe: These are the sons of Shem: Elam and Asshur and Arpachshad and Lud and Aram.

verses.en: And the children of Aram; Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Arão: Uz, Hul, Geter e Más.
verses.en_web: The sons of Aram were: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Aram: Uz and Hul and Gether and Mash.

verses.en: And Arphaxad begat Salah; and Salah begat Eber.
verses.pt: Arfaxade gerou a Selá; e Selá gerou a Eber.
verses.en_web: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah. Shelah became the father of Eber.
verses.en_bbe: And Arpachshad became the father of Shelah; and Shelah became the father of Eber.

verses.en: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of one was Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.
verses.pt: A Eber nasceram dois filhos: o nome de um foi Pelegue, porque nos seus dias foi dividida a terra; e o nome de seu irmão foi Joctã.
verses.en_web: To Eber were born two sons. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. His brother’s name was Joktan.
verses.en_bbe: And Eber had two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, because in his time the peoples of the earth became separate; and his brother's name was Joktan.

verses.en: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazar-maveth, and Jerah,
verses.pt: Joctã gerou a Almodá, Selefe, Hazarmavé, Jerá,
verses.en_web: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
verses.en_bbe: And Joktan was the father of Almodad and Sheleph and Hazarmaveth and Jerah

verses.en: And Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,
verses.pt: Hadorão, Usal, Dicla,
verses.en_web: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
verses.en_bbe: And Hadoram and Uzal and Diklah

verses.en: And Obal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
verses.pt: Obal, Abimael, Sebá,
verses.en_web: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
verses.en_bbe: And Obal and Abimael and Sheba

verses.en: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these were the sons of Joktan.
verses.pt: Ofir, Havilá e Jobabe: todos esses foram filhos de Joctã.
verses.en_web: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
verses.en_bbe: And Ophir and Havilah and Jobab; all these were the sons of Joktan.

verses.en: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest unto Sephar a mount of the east.
verses.pt: E foi a sua habitação desde Messa até Sefar, montanha do oriente.
verses.en_web: Their dwelling extended from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.
verses.en_bbe: And their country was from Mesha, in the direction of Sephar, the mountain of the east.

verses.en: These are the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, after their nations.
verses.pt: Esses são os filhos de Sem segundo as suas famílias, segundo as suas línguas, em suas terras, segundo as suas nações.
verses.en_web: These are the sons of Shem, by their families, according to their languages, lands, and nations.
verses.en_bbe: These, with their families and their languages and their lands and their nations, are the offspring of Shem.

verses.en: These are the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations: and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.
verses.pt: Essas são as famílias dos filhos de Noé segundo as suas gerações, em suas nações; e delas foram disseminadas as nações na terra depois do dilúvio.
verses.en_web: These are the families of the sons of Noah, by their generations, according to their nations. The nations divided from these in the earth after the flood.
verses.en_bbe: These are the families of the sons of Noah, in the order of their generations and their nations: from these came all the nations of the earth after the great flow of waters.
